description: Mean squared error between student and teacher positive-minus-negative score margins, with each [B, 2] row ordered as [positive, negative] (paper §3, Eqs. (11)–(12); .autopilot/sources/paper.txt:418-439; implementation src/topologies/implementations/losses/margin_mse.py:1-36).

examples.code:
import tempfile
import torch
from topologies import Trainer, build, synth
root = tempfile.mkdtemp()
@synth.generator
def samples(ctx):
    features = torch.randn(6, generator=ctx.rng.torch)
    teacher_scores = torch.stack((features[:2].sum(), features[2:4].sum()))
    return {"inputs": synth.Tensor(features), "teacher_scores": synth.Tensor(teacher_scores)}
dataset = synth.Spec("margin-mse-distillation", generator=samples, size=16, splits={"train": 1.0}, seed=11, root=root, monitor="none").run()
train = dataset.for_recipe("regression", split="train", input_field="inputs", target_field="teacher_scores", preserve_shape=True)
model = build("mlp", "tiny", in_features=6, out_features=2)
trainer = Trainer(model, train, recipe="regression", recipe_config={"loss": "margin-mse"}, batch_size=4, max_epochs=1, device="cpu")
trainer.fit()
examples.title: Distill paired scores with Margin-MSE

name: Margin-MSE pairwise distillation loss

parameters.additional parameters: No additional parameters are supported; unsupported keys in **params raise ValueError
parameters.ignore_index: must be None because the objective does not define ignored pairs
parameters.logits_or_prediction: finite floating-point student scores shaped [B, 2], columns [positive, negative], with B >= 1
parameters.reduction: none returns one squared margin error per pair [B], mean averages B errors, or sum totals them (default mean; paper §3 Eq. (12))
parameters.targets: finite floating-point teacher scores shaped [B, 2], matching student dtype and device, columns [positive, negative]; detached because teacher scores are labels (paper §3)
